items.name: Turmeric
items.tradition: Traditionally used in household food and care practices.
uses: Turmeric paste for minor wounds is documented in the CSP.
Used as a kitchen ingredient in traditional practices.
The project demonstrated turmeric-based practices during awareness sessions.
items.howTo: The CSP describes turmeric paste for minor wounds and turmeric milk as examples discussed during awareness activities. Follow local guidance and seek professional care for significant wounds or illness.
items.safety: Traditional use does not establish that a remedy treats or cures disease. Avoid using home remedies as a substitute for professional medical care.
